House Painters Marietta

You’re looking for a reliable painter in Marietta. Build Heritage gives free, written, itemized quotes and replies within one business day.

How a Marietta painting project starts

  1. Request a quote – Fill out the online form or email info@buildheritage.org.
  2. We review your details – We note surface type, size, and any special requests.
  3. You receive a written, itemized quote – Delivered within one business day.
  4. Schedule the work – Pick a date that fits your calendar.
  5. We paint your home – Using quality materials and skilled labor.

What you get and the cost

  • Eight trades: Painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, roofing & tiles, packing & moving.
  • Licensed and insured in Georgia.
  • Cost guide (updated August 2026):
  • Full roof replacement: $9,000–$20,000
  • Whole‑home interior repaint: $3,000–$8,000
  • Hold back 10‑15% on top of the quote for hidden issues.

FAQ

Do you paint residential homes? Yes, we serve residential properties in Marietta and the surrounding metro Atlanta area.

What areas do you cover? We work in Marietta, Atlanta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

How long does it take to get a quote? We reply within one business day.
